name: Tracks EC2 Instance
description: This Qualys host is that EC2 instance: Qualys reported its CLOUD_RESOURCE_ID with CLOUD_PROVIDER AWS and CLOUD_SERVICE EC2, and aws_core holds an instance with exactly that instance_id. Drawn only when the instance exists; the instance is never written (req-qualys-ec2-link). The target is closed to aws_core's EC2 instance type, an optional vocabulary dependency declared in depends_on: aws_core collects the source of record and no neutral compute-instance type exists to target instead.

source_field.description: The Qualys field the instance id was read from. Only CLOUD_RESOURCE_ID links; the deprecated EC2_INSTANCE_ID never does (req-qualys-ec2-link-5).
